title_en: Clearing opportunity! At Kodra e Diellit-Lindje Residence, 1+1 Apartment for Sale, Ideal Investment Opportunity!
description_en: Clearing opportunity! At Kodra e Diellit-Lindje Residence, 1+1 Apartment for Sale, Ideal Investment Opportunity!! The apartment is located in one of the buildings of the Kodra e Diellit-Lindje Residence, with contemporary thermal facade works, windows equipped with thermal double glazing, acoustic insulation, hydraulic systems of the Geberit brand, installations for a central heating - cooling multisplit air conditioning system, three elevators of one of the most popular brands in the market.
